## New Features
- Unified macOS workspace motion with smooth per-digit rolling counters, morphing cost curves, animated ranking bars, and instant in-memory date-range switching. - Added Antigravity subagent tracking and merged Codex and Antigravity into a single Subagents overview card with inline tool and model badges. - Added per-segment hover readouts on Tool and Model bars to inspect local, remote, and Fast shares individually. - Recognize historical import formats automatically and keep range previews and conflict choices inside the Data card.
## Fixes
- Fixed Mechanical HUD drum rolling alignment, interruptible fade transitions, and VSync-synced frame pacing. - Fixed Records pagination indicator drift, conversation search popover flicker, overview vertical jumps when switching dates, and redundant system tooltips. - Improved scan recovery and avoided repeated live scans when database WAL files close.
